title: Source: src/agent_runtime/prompts
summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.
html:
Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/prompts

src/agent_runtime/prompts/init.py

Python · Tier A

Prompt access compatibility, loaded independently of sealed source resources.

src/agent_runtime/prompts/build.py

Python · Tier A

Compile explicit prompt authoring inputs into a deterministic release database. The compiler checks source bindings and helper variables; the CLI supports byte-for-byte verification or atomic read-only publication. It never discovers JSON inputs by walking directories or starts the application.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
encode 23 Serialize catalog payloads deterministically with sorted keys, compact separators and literal Unicode so identical authoring inputs produce comparable bytes.
compile_database 32 Validate the three named authoring inputs, helper placeholder contracts, source fingerprints and composite spans, then replace the supplied destination with the compiled catalog, feedback and migration tables. This low-level writer removes an existing destination; the CLI builds in temporary storage before atomic publication. No runtime application imports or model calls are required.
main 150 Compile a temporary candidate and either compare exact bytes for --check or publish a read-only output through a unique same-directory temporary file. Restore Windows destination permissions if replacement fails and remove staging files; stale checks exit unsuccessfully without rewriting the output.

src/agent_runtime/prompts/catalog.py

Python · Tier A

Load and validate the sealed release instruction database, then expose canonical and effective request text. Definition validates template variables and supports local previews; source_skill supplies registry wording, while feedback/history views support exact projection and migration. Missing or damaged resources fail initialization.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
digest 28 Return the SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 prompt text for compiled manifests, source bindings and user- default change detection.
Definition 36 Hold one detached release definition, its full/optional compact wording, helper placeholder contract and provenance. The frozen record fixes its attributes; nested metadata is consumed as trusted catalog data.
Definition.body 53 Return an available full or compact release variant; reject unknown variants and compact requests when no compact body exists.
Definition.skill 61 Derive the owning Skill from skills.<id> module metadata for editor filtering; return an empty category for other source owners.
Definition.validate 67 Require nonempty text and, for helper templates, valid dollar-placeholder syntax with exactly the registered variable set. Preserve text unchanged; non-template instruction prose has no placeholder requirement.
Definition.render 91 Validate a draft and supplied variable names, then substitute stringified preview values for a helper template. Missing values become readable ValueErrors; ordinary prose is returned unchanged. No model or tool is invoked.
definitions 110 Read the packaged database once in immutable read-only mode, verify SQLite integrity, schema, ordered payload digest and each source/placeholder contract, then publish a read-only definition mapping. Missing or invalid resources raise RuntimeError; authoring JSON is never a runtime fallback.
full 143 Canonical source text for an explicitly identified instruction producer.
effective 151 Resolve the requested ID directly from the current request's override snapshot and compact choice, or use release wording when no override snapshot is bound. This explicit-ID accessor does not perform the original-string comparison used by guidance.select.
request_owner 168 Bind standalone finalization/probe clients to their Controller's prompt owner.
source_text 185 Assemble a canonical composite from its explicitly owned instruction blocks.
source_skill 192 First-party registry metadata comes from release resources, not docstrings.
canonical_key 219 Map legacy helper-template keys to registered helpers.<key> IDs while preserving already canonical or unregistered keys.
usage_locations 225 Include callers that assemble a shared block into another instruction.
guidance_blocks 237 Expose fresh top-level guidance dictionaries, optionally restricted to one compatibility module owner. Runtime variants come from compiled definitions, not from importing every guidance_compact module.
feedback_sources 248 Cache the sealed database's exact digest-to-span compositions, converting JSON lists to tuples for guidance history consumers.
historical_defaults 259 Read the immutable legacy key/version/digest set used to distinguish old bundled defaults from user customizations during migration.

src/agent_runtime/prompts/guidance_compact.py

Python · Tier A

Compatibility view of the sealed instruction catalog.

src/agent_runtime/prompts/memory_store.py

Python · Tier A

Provide Controller-owned prompt storage through the RAM record authority. Legacy template methods remain available for import compatibility; PromptOverrides owns current edits and request snapshots, and the hub handles checkpoint/recovery. Direct SQL access is rejected.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
MemoryPromptTemplateStore 18 Adapt the legacy template interface and revisioned overrides to the Controller's prompts record domain. Live reads/writes use RAM authority; the hub owns recovery and checkpoint persistence.
MemoryPromptTemplateStore.seed_defaults 19 Release defaults live in the sealed resource, never in user state.
MemoryPromptTemplateStore.get 72 Normalize a legacy template key and return a detached active record, or None when absent/inactive unless explicitly requested.
MemoryPromptTemplateStore.list 82 Return legacy records sorted by key, excluding inactive rows by default. Release defaults and editor overrides are separate collections.
MemoryPromptTemplateStore.upsert 91 Atomically write a legacy template row with copied metadata, preserve its original creation timestamp and return a detached record. Reject an empty key; this compatibility operation does not edit the sealed release catalog.
repository 117 Reuse the hub's one prompts repository or create it on first access. Reject a different recovery path rather than silently binding another prompt store to the same authority.

src/agent_runtime/prompts/overrides.py

Python · Tier A

Preserve user instruction edits separately from release defaults. Revision-checked saves/resets publish immutable snapshots; one-time migration archives legacy evidence and retains uncertain edits. The same owner works with Controller records or standalone transactional SQL, without changing compact settings.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
PromptConflict 34 Report a stale global prompt revision so editors reload before saving or restoring over another writer's changes.
initialize 40 Create the override and migration/revision tables in a caller-owned SQLite transaction. Release defaults are not seeded into user state.
schemas 55 Declare compound override keys and the singleton state key for the Controller record repository and checkpoint format.
PromptSnapshot 67 Carry one immutable override revision and detached rows into a request, keeping in-flight selection stable across later editor writes.
PromptSnapshot.resolve 74 Resolve an available variant through its validated override, falling back to the shipped body for invalid retained text. A missing compact variant uses full wording; invalid/retired rows stay stored for editor inspection.
SQLRecords 91 Administration-only adapter for standalone callers; requests use snapshots.
SQLRecords.get 99 Read one trusted schema table by its singleton or compound key and detach the SQLite row. Table identifiers are internal constants, not user input.
SQLRecords.find 107 Detach all rows of an internal administration table for migration or snapshot construction.
SQLRecords.put 112 Insert or replace an internal row with parameterized values inside the caller's transaction; this adapter does not commit on its own.
SQLRecords.delete 122 Delete a legacy template by key or a prompt override by ID and variant, leaving transaction ownership with the caller.
PromptOverrides 130 Own revision-checked editor changes, one-time legacy migration and immutable request snapshots over either Controller records or standalone SQL. Preserve uncertain historical text while validating all effective registered templates.
PromptOverrides.import_legacy 146 Import missing legacy rows only before migration and only when no committed Controller recovery generation already owns the state. Read the source file without changing it, validate its supported schema and retain existing destination rows.
PromptOverrides.atomic 185 Serialize writes using the owner lock and either records.atomic or BEGIN IMMEDIATE on standalone SQLite. Invalidate the cached snapshot after success; callback failures propagate through the transaction boundary.
PromptOverrides.snapshot 199 Reuse the immutable captured snapshot until the RAM state revision changes or a standalone write invalidates it. Standalone callers must mutate through this owner; repeated reads do not poll external SQL writers.
PromptOverrides.migrate 228 Archive recovered legacy rows, then classify them once without copying bundled defaults into overrides. Keep unknown or incompatible edits for review and record a durable migrated marker so later reset does not resurrect old rows.
PromptOverrides.preserve_legacy_recovery 288 Write a content-addressed JSON archive before retiring legacy rows, using a private temporary file, fsync and atomic replacement. Reuse a matching existing archive; fail on differing bytes or I/O errors so migration does not silently lose its source evidence.
PromptOverrides.mutate 336 Validate a requested save, then compare the caller's expected global revision and atomically save or remove matching overrides. Saving exact release text removes an override; no-op changes do not advance revision. Return the accepted snapshot without changing compact-mode settings.
PromptOverrides.detail 397 Project editor inspection data from one override snapshot and current release definitions: effective/default/custom text, validation errors, changed-base hashes, source locations and retired variants. Unknown identities without retained rows raise KeyError; invalid overrides remain visible but do not become effective.

src/agent_runtime/prompts/store.py

Python · Tier A

Maintain helper-template compatibility around the sealed prompt catalog and user overrides. Controller paths use the RAM repository; standalone callers can use SQLite and explicit custom defaults. PromptFetcher selects a request snapshot, renders dollar placeholders locally and keeps canonical-history reads separate from effective outgoing text.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
utc_now_iso 29 Return an ISO timestamp in UTC.
default_prompt_db_path 37 Resolve the user override store from AOR_AGENT_USER_PROMPTS_DB_PATH, otherwise use userprompts.db beside the configured legacy prompt path or state directory. The packaged release database is a different resource.
load_default_templates 126 Build detached fallback records keyed by legacy helper-template name. The canonical path reads the compiled database; a custom defaults path retains the explicit JSON compatibility route.
PromptTemplateRecord 145 One prompt template record.
PromptTemplateRenderError 157 Raised when a prompt template cannot be rendered safely.
extract_template_variables 166 Return ordered placeholder names used by a prompt template body.
validate_template_body 176 Validate a prompt template body and return it unchanged.
render_template_body 187 Render one prompt template body with explicit variables.
PromptTemplateStore 200 Factory for the legacy template-record API: route Controller-owned paths to the RAM repository and use SQLite only for standalone callers. Editor overrides are managed separately by PromptOverrides; the release catalog cannot be opened as user state.
PromptTemplateStore.get 253 Return one template record by key.
PromptTemplateStore.list 268 Return stored prompt templates.
PromptTemplateStore.upsert 278 Insert or replace a prompt template record.
PromptTemplateStore.seed_defaults 320 Legacy standalone operation that writes missing or older helper records while preserving equal/newer versions. The live Controller repository implements this method as a no-op because release defaults stay in the sealed resource.
PromptFetcher 342 Resolve helper-template text through the request-pinned catalog/override path when available, with a compatibility stored-template/default route for explicit custom sources. Substitute variables locally and report missing or unrenderable templates; no model call occurs here.
PromptFetcher.defaults 359 Lazily load and retain fallback helper records from the sealed release catalog or the caller's explicit custom JSON path.
PromptFetcher.get 382 Return the body for one active prompt template.
PromptFetcher.render 460 Prefer the pinned catalog/override template and substitute its values. On the legacy route, optionally use prompt-cache builders; an unrenderable stored body may fall back to a distinct default with a warning. Unknown keys or failures shared by the fallback remain errors.
PromptFetcher.lines 528 Render a template and split it into prompt lines.
forget_prompt_fetcher 536 Release a deleted workspace's process-local prompt content.
get_prompt_fetcher 545 Reuse a process-local fetcher by configured path, preserving an explicitly cached legacy embedded alias. A new fetcher creates the appropriate store, attaches/migrates overrides and is cached for subsequent helper calls.
configure_prompt_fetcher 577 Bind and cache a new fetcher for an explicit user path, importing eligible legacy customizations before use. Reuse the Controller repository when that path already has a RAM owner.
seed_default_prompt_templates 595 Expose the legacy seeding operation and refresh its process-local fetcher. RAM stores intentionally return no inserted defaults; this is not the release-catalog compiler.
render_prompt 607 Render from a request/canonical context without creating a process-default store; only unbound callers use the cached default fetcher.
prompt_lines 617 Render one prompt template as lines through the default process fetcher.
initialize_prompt_schema 624 Require the supported agent_prompts schema version, then create legacy templates, their status index and override/revision tables in the caller's transaction.
